description: This Java class 'LocalProxy' provides functionality to proxy content URIs to local file URIs by copying media content from a remote URI to a local file within the app's media directory, and then returning a content URI for the local file.

classes.name: LocalProxy
classes.description: A utility class that proxies content URIs to local file URIs by copying media content into the app's local storage and returning a URI for the local file.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Public static method that takes a Context and a Uri, and returns a Single emitting a Uri after copying remote content to local storage.

methods.name: proxyContentUriToLocalFileUri
methods.description: Private static method that copies content from a remote URI to a local file and returns a content URI for the local file.
